mapper.insert: insert into vote_record(vote_id, voter_user_id, voter_user_name, vote_decision, vote_comment, create_time) values (#{voteId}, #{voterUserId}, #{voterUserName}, #{voteDecision}, #{voteComment}, now())
mapper.select: select count(1) from vote_record where vote_id = #{voteId} and vote_decision = 1
select count(1) from vote_record where vote_id = #{voteId} and vote_decision = 2
select id, vote_id, voter_user_id, voter_user_name, vote_decision, vote_comment, create_time from vote_record where vote_id = #{voteId} order by id asc
